masked_oob_finetune_probe.interpretation: masking out-of-bounds teacher keypoints during this fine-tune regressed all-point PCK and was not selected

hand_landmarks.interpretation: 21-landmark student improved this turn but still needs a substantial PCK repair before browser promotion
hand_landmarks.best_selected_checkpoint_policy: selected_by_validation_among_local M3JA landmark probes; later heatmap CE and hard-geometry probes were not promoted because validation did not improve.

best_checkpoint_re_eval_after_trainer_pa.interpretation: compatibility check; trainer changes did not perturb legacy checkpoint scoring

worst_sample_error_report.interpretation: Worst samples cluster around hard geometry: near-face/high or low hands, edge/OOB keypoints, tiny hand boxes, and large/ambiguous hand extents. This argues for crop/teacher-label quality repair instead of blind longer fine-tuning.

stratified_error_probe.interpretation: The selected checkpoint is substantially weaker on edge/OOB/small and vertical-extreme hands than centered non-edge hands.

visible_heatmap_ce_probe.interpretation: Classic Gaussian heatmap CE did not validate; it tied test PCK but underperformed selected validation.

hard_geometry_oversampling_probe.interpretation: Targeted geometry oversampling made only tiny test gains and still missed selected validation; it is not enough by itself.

decoder_coord_mode_probe.interpretation: The existing checkpoint should continue using legacy soft-argmax coordinate mapping; changing decoder mapping without retraining regresses right-hand PCK.

worst_case_summary.interpretation: Quality filtering modestly improves all-test, non-edge, in-bounds, and tight PCK, but edge/OOB/small slices regress; remaining worst samples still show blurred, warped, edge-truncated, and teacher-ambiguous crops.

quality_filter_probe.interpretation: Removing the lowest-confidence OOB/low-texture training tail is a real but small gain for general held-out landmark accuracy; it is not sufficient for hard edge/OOB cases.

hard_geometry_augmentation_probe.interpretation: Hard augmentation nudged the exact hard slices upward but reduced overall and tight held-out PCK, so it is diagnostic rather than a promotion checkpoint.

high_resolution_heatmap_probe.interpretation: A 64x64 heatmap head trained from scratch learned, but by epoch 30 it was far behind the current 32x32 best and was stopped as an inefficient local lever.

quality_filter_plus_mild_hard_aug_probe.interpretation: Mild hard augmentation after quality filtering improved only the small-area slice and regressed all-test, tight, edge, OOB, non-edge, and in-bounds metrics.

quality_cache_audit.metadata_gap: perhand-hires has frames.npy, kpts.npy, and splits.json but no rows.json, so source-frame relabeling requires recovering the generator or rebuilding the cache with row metadata.
quality_cache_audit.interpretation: The held-out tail is dominated by edge/OOB, low-texture, and clean-high-error teacher/student disagreements. This confirms the next lever is teacher/crop-cache repair and row metadata, not another blind fine-tune.

row_preserving_cache_builder_smoke.interpretation: The metadata gap has a working rebuild path: each generated crop preserves source cache, source row index, hand key, label, clip, frame index, teacher hand box, derived per-hand crop box, and original teacher landmarks.

current_selected_checkpoint_on_c35.interpretation: Context 0.35 improves over the context 0.20 row-preserving rebuild (0.609 PCK@0.10) but is still harder than the old metadata-poor perhand-hires cache.

test_pop_top32.interpretation: The top held-out disagreements remain very hard under rerun teacher labels; this is diagnostic and not a gate metric.

source_preserved_relabel_slice.interpretation: The row-preserving and targeted-relabel path now supports both PopSign and ASL Citizen, and replacement caches can remove original bad source hands. However, additive, replacement, and masked-OOB short adaptation probes all regressed below the warm-start baseline. The next useful step is stricter relabel acceptance and edge/OOB label policy, not simply adding more relabeled rows.

perhand_refinement_candidate.interpretation: This validates train-quality filtering as a useful lever and sets a new local per-hand best, but the model is still far below M3JA gates. The next repair should rebuild teacher/crop-cache quality and metadata rather than blindly extending optimizer time.
